=At the end of an enemy unit's action, if it is within <color=#f26c1c>6 tiles</color>, Faye gains Confectance Index, applies <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>, and deals Physical damage and stability damage.
column2: Pada akhir aksi unit musuh, jika unit itu berada dalam <color=#f26c1c>6 tile</color>, Faye mendapatkan Confectance Index, memberikan <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>, serta memberikan Physical damage dan Stability damage.
